paper_title: NuSTAR bounds on radiatively decaying particles from M82
notes: Curve extracted from the vector path (orange stroke, width 3) of FigBounds.pdf (Fig. 2 of the paper), the boundary of the region 'Excluded by NuSTAR observations of M82'. Axis calibration from major tick marks: x=92.34px=10 keV, 469.13px/decade; y=15.50px=1e-10 GeV^-1, 172.375px/decade; curve vertices lie at exact 0.1-dex mass spacing, confirming they are the authors' computed grid points. Paper convention L = g_agamma a E.B is identical to the canonical -(g/4)aFF~. Bound from likelihood test statistic threshold TS=2.7 (one-sided half-chi-squared, 95% CL), main analysis with free isotropic background (conservative choice; OFF-region/power-law variants give slightly stronger limits). Astrophysical (stellar-production) bound, no dark-matter density assumption. Curve reported over the plotted range 10-631 keV plus the crossing of the top of the frame (g=1e-10) at ~719 keV; the first vertex of the drawn path (7.9 keV) lies outside the plotted axes and is omitted.
